headline: Summerlin Rear-End Car Crash
articleBody:
The client was stopped, waiting to make a right-hand turn. Her car was angled and she was looking left and yielding to cross traffic when she was hit from behind. There was less than $2,000 in damage to the rear of the client's car. The client suffered structural lumbar (low back) and cervical (neck) injuries.

Outcome: $660,000 Out-Of-Court Settlement
